text:
Sea's digital entertainment (Garena) revenue rose 26.1%, from US$1.9 billion in FY2024 to US$2.4 billion (US$2,408.8 million) in FY2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.100; p.F-3]. Per the report, the increase was primarily driven by growth in Garena's active user base combined with deepened paying-user penetration: average quarterly active users (Game QAUs) rose 5.7% from 622.3 million to 657.7 million, while average quarterly paying users (Game QPUs) grew more sharply, up 23.9% from 50.5 million to 62.6 million [Sea, FY2025, p.100].

This also fed through to profitability and cash flow — management notes that higher digital entertainment gross profit in 2025 was due to the larger active user base and deeper paying-user penetration, and that stronger bookings (GAAP revenue plus the change in deferred revenue) for digital entertainment contributed to the increase in operating cash flow [Sea, FY2025, p.107].
